one_liner: Workspace for docs, wikis, databases and project tracking.
auth_note: Internal connection token or personal access token (static Bearer); OAuth for public/OAuth integrations.
access_note: Create an internal connection or personal access token in the Notion developer portal; works on all plans, rate-limited (180 req/min).
api_note: Pages, databases/data sources, blocks, users, comments, search, file uploads. Endpoint count not stated on pages read.
mcp_note: Hosted official MCP at https://mcp.notion.com/mcp (OAuth); also open-source makenotion/notion-mcp-server.

evidence.quote: Choose a personal access token, internal connection, OAuth integration, or public integration based on who will use your app
Step 1: Get a personal access token
GET /v1/pages/b55c9c91-384d-452b-81db-d1ef79372b75 HTTP/1.1 Authorization: Bearer {INTEGRATION_TOKEN}
Notion MCP (https://mcp.notion.com/mcp) is our hosted, actively maintained server.
All other plans | 180 requests per minute (an average of 3 per second)

one_liner: Low-code database and app platform for collaborative workflows.
auth_note: Personal access tokens (Bearer) for own use; OAuth access tokens for third-party integrations. Legacy API keys removed Feb 2024.
access_note: Create a PAT at airtable.com/create/tokens or register an OAuth integration; free plan limited to 1,000 API calls/workspace/month.
api_note: Records CRUD, bases/tables/fields metadata, webhooks, comments, collaborators; 5 req/s per base.
mcp_note: Hosted official MCP at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp (OAuth), available on all plans.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
Free plan - 1000 calls per workspace per month
curl https://api.airtable.com/v0/YOUR_BASE_ID/YOUR_TABLE_ID_OR_NAME -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
The server is available to all users on all plans.
Airtable enforces a rate limit of 5 requests per second (per base)

one_liner: Issue tracking and project management tool for software teams.
auth_note: Personal API keys (admins/permitted members) or OAuth2 (authorization code with PKCE; client_credentials for app actor).
access_note: Create a personal API key in Settings > Account > Security & Access, or create an OAuth2 app in workspace settings; no approval step found.
api_note: GraphQL API covering issues, projects, cycles, teams, comments, initiatives, customers, webhooks.

evidence.quote: Use OAuth 2.0 or personal API keys to authenticate your requests to the Linear API
Admins and permitted Members can create personal API keys from Settings > Account > Security & Access.
Once you have obtained a valid access token, you can make a request to Linear's GraphQL API.
claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you're building applications to integrate with Linear.

one_liner: Atlassian issue and project tracking for software and business teams.
auth_note: Jira Cloud: email + API token via Basic auth, or OAuth 2.0 (3LO); Forge/Connect for apps.
access_note: Sign up for a Jira Cloud site and create an API token (account settings) or register a 3LO app in developer console; free-plan availability not verified on pages read.
api_note: Jira Cloud platform REST API v2/v3: issues, projects, search/JQL, users, workflows, fields, webhooks; endpoint count not read.
mcp_note: Atlassian Rovo remote MCP server (atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server) covers Jira, Confluence, JSM.

evidence.quote: -u fred@example.com:freds_api_token -X GET https://your-domain.atlassian.net/rest/api/2/issue/createmeta
Select Create API token with scopes. Give your API token a name that describes its purpose.
Jira Cloud Platform REST API v3
Summarize and search Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Bitbucket, Projects, Goals, and more without switching tools.
For simple scripts or to make REST API calls yourself, see Basic auth for REST APIs.

one_liner: Work management platform for tasks, projects and team goals.
auth_note: Personal access token (Bearer) or OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; service accounts are Enterprise-tier.
access_note: Generate a PAT in the Asana developer console or register an OAuth app; free domains get 150 req/min.
api_note: Tasks, projects, sections, workspaces, users, teams, portfolios, goals, webhooks, custom fields, etc.
mcp_note: Official Asana MCP server (https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp), V2 documented; V1 beta also documented.
blocker_note: Service accounts need Enterprise; not required for PAT/OAuth use.

evidence.quote: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
Domain type | Maximum requests per minute | Free | 150
curl https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/users/me -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN"
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and other applications to access the Asana Work Graph.
Service Accounts (SAs) are long-lived tokens that provide programmatic access to the API. Service Accounts are an Enterprise tier feature

one_liner: Work operating system for boards, projects and workflows.
auth_note: Personal V2 API token (Authorization header) or OAuth for apps; MCP uses OAuth 2.1.
access_note: Free developer/sandbox account available; API is a free feature across all plans with daily call limits; personal token from Administration > Connections or profile.
api_note: GraphQL API v2: boards, items, columns, groups, users, workspaces, docs, updates, webhooks.
mcp_note: Official hosted MCP at https://mcp.monday.com/mcp (OAuth or Bearer API token).

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
A developer account (also called a sandbox account) is a free monday.com account designed for building and testing monday apps and API integrations.
curl -X POST https://api.monday.com/v2 -H "Authorization: xxxx" -d '{"query": "query { me { id name } }"}'
"url": "https://mcp.monday.com/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN"}
maintains the API service as a free feature across all plans

one_liner: All-in-one productivity and project management platform.
auth_note: Personal API token in Authorization header; OAuth flow for apps built for others.
access_note: Any ClickUp account can generate a personal token; OAuth app creation in ClickUp settings. Plan-based rate limits not read.
api_note: API v2: tasks, lists, folders, spaces, comments, time tracking, goals, webhooks, custom fields, docs.

evidence.quote: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token.
Anyone with a ClickUp account can generate a personal token.
curl --request POST --url https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/oauth/token
Our MCP server URL is https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp.
Build Apps for others - OAuth Flow

one_liner: Collaborative docs with tables and automations; now branded Superhuman Docs.
auth_note: API token generated in account settings (Bearer), scoped to specific docs or all content; tokens expire with notification.
access_note: Generate a token at docs.superhuman.com/account under API connections; plan restrictions on API not stated on pages read.
api_note: Coda API v1 (docs, tables, rows, formulas, controls, pages); exact endpoint count not verified. Plugins SDK separate.
mcp_note: Superhuman Docs runs an official MCP server (see Coda guide and Superhuman help article); community coda-mcp also exists.
blocker_note: Rebrand to Superhuman Docs; plan limits on API unverified.

evidence.quote: A token is tied to your account, so it can never do more than you can in Docs.
Go to docs.superhuman.com/account. Scroll down to the API connections section
type: sdk.AuthenticationType.CodaApiHeaderBearerToken
Superhuman Docs runs an MCP server built on the open Model Context Protocol standard
Choose what your token can access. All content is selected by default.

one_liner: Spreadsheet-style work management and project collaboration platform.
access_note: API restricted to Business and Enterprise plans; no free tier or sandbox found on pages read.
api_note: Sheets, rows, columns, workspaces, folders, users, reports, sights, attachments, webhooks.
mcp_note: Official MCP server at https://mcp.smartsheet.com (US; .eu/.au regions); requires Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management.
blocker_note: API and MCP need Business/Enterprise/Advanced Work Management plan.

evidence.quote: The Smartsheet API utilizes OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans
https://api.smartsheet.com/2.0/
Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
A Smarsheet API access token allows you to access and manage your organization's Smartsheet plan and data via the Smartsheet API.

one_liner: Time tracking, expenses and invoicing software.
auth_note: Personal access token from Harvest ID developers page plus Harvest-Account-Id header; OAuth2 for apps.
access_note: API included for all accounts including free and trial; create PAT at id.getharvest.com/developers.
api_note: API v2: time entries, projects, clients, tasks, users, invoices, estimates, expenses, reports.
mcp_note: Harvest MCP documented by Harvest support at https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp (new; one aggregator page claimed none exists).
blocker_note: Official MCP page is a support article; low-detail excerpt only.

evidence.quote: A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API.
Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts)
curl https://api.harvestapp.com/v2/invoices -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN"
"harvest": { "url": "https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp" }
